tables.name: assets
check_constraints: ck_assets_archive_state:((lifecycle_status = 'archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archive_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (lifecycle_status <> 'archived' AND archived_at IS NULL AND archive_reason IS NULL))
ck_assets_production_year:production_year IS NULL OR production_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200
ck_assets_warranty_chronology:warranty_end_date IS NULL OR warranty_start_date IS NULL OR warranty_end_date >= warranty_start_date

tables.name: checklist_template_items
check_constraints: ck_checklist_items_numeric_fields:response_type = 'numeric' OR (minimum_value IS NULL AND maximum_value IS NULL AND expected_unit IS NULL)
ck_checklist_items_numeric_range:minimum_value IS NULL OR maximum_value IS NULL OR minimum_value <= maximum_value

tables.name: checklist_templates
check_constraints: ck_checklist_templates_archive_state:((status = 'archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'active' AND archived_at IS NULL))

tables.name: inventory_movements
check_constraints: ck_inventory_movements_transfer:((movement_type IN ('transfer_out', 'transfer_in') AND transfer_group_id IS NOT NULL AND source_location_id IS NOT NULL AND destination_location_id IS NOT NULL AND source_location_id <> destination_location_id) OR (movement_type NOT IN ('transfer_out', 'transfer_in') AND transfer_group_id IS NULL))

tables.name: locations
check_constraints: ck_locations_not_self_parent:parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

tables.name: maintenance_logs
check_constraints: ck_logs_follow_up_result:((maintenance_result = 'resolved' AND follow_up_required = false) OR (maintenance_result <> 'resolved' AND follow_up_required = true))

tables.name: maintenance_tickets
check_constraints: ck_tickets_cancelled_state:((status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NULL))
ck_tickets_closed_chronology:closed_at IS NULL OR (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at >= resolved_at)
ck_tickets_closed_state:((status = 'closed' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'closed' AND closed_at IS NULL))

ck_tickets_priority_matrix:((impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'low') OR (impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'medium' AND priority = 'low') OR (impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'high' AND priority = 'medium') OR (impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'immediate' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'medium' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'low') OR (impact = 'medium' AND urgency = 'medium' AND priority = 'medium') OR (impact = 'medium' AND urgency = 'high' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'medium' AND urgency = 'immediate' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'high' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'medium') OR (impact = 'high' AND urgency = 'medium' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'high' AND urgency = 'high' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'high' AND urgency = 'immediate' AND priority = 'critical') OR (impact = 'critical' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'critical' AND urgency = 'medium' AND priority = 'high') OR (impact = 'critical' AND urgency = 'high' AND priority = 'critical') OR (impact = 'critical' AND urgency = 'immediate' AND priority = 'critical'))
ck_tickets_resolution_state:((status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NULL))
ck_tickets_subcategory_requires_category:subcategory_id IS NULL OR category_id IS NOT NULL

ck_tickets_waiting_state:((status = 'waiting' AND waiting_reason IS NOT NULL AND waiting_previous_status IN ('assigned', 'in_progress')) OR (status <> 'waiting' AND waiting_reason IS NULL AND waiting_previous_status IS NULL))

tables.name: part_reorder_configurations
check_constraints: ck_part_reorder_thresholds:minimum_stock >= 0 AND reorder_point >= minimum_stock AND (maximum_stock IS NULL OR maximum_stock >= reorder_point)

tables.name: preventive_maintenance_plans
check_constraints: ck_pm_plans_date_range:end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date
ck_pm_plans_lead_grace:lead_time_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND grace_period_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365

ck_pm_plans_lifecycle_state:((status = 'active' AND is_active = true AND paused_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND archive_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'paused' AND is_active = false AND paused_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND archive_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'archived' AND is_active = false AND archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archive_reason IS NOT NULL))
ck_pm_plans_next_due:next_due_date IS NULL OR next_due_date >= start_date

tables.name: spare_parts
check_constraints: ck_spare_parts_archive_state:((lifecycle_status = 'archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archive_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (lifecycle_status <> 'archived' AND archived_at IS NULL AND archive_reason IS NULL))
ck_spare_parts_thresholds:minimum_stock >= 0 AND reorder_point >= minimum_stock AND (maximum_stock IS NULL OR maximum_stock >= reorder_point)

tables.name: stock_locations
check_constraints: ck_stock_locations_archive_state:((lifecycle_status = 'archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archive_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (lifecycle_status <> 'archived' AND archived_at IS NULL AND archive_reason IS NULL))

tables.name: ticket_comment_attachments
check_constraints: ck_ticket_comment_attachment_source:((asset_attachment_id IS NOT NULL AND work_order_attachment_id IS NULL) OR (asset_attachment_id IS NULL AND work_order_attachment_id IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: ticket_escalation_events
check_constraints: ck_ticket_escalations_clock:clock_type IS NULL OR clock_type IN ('first_response', 'resolution')

tables.name: ticket_sla_events
check_constraints: ck_ticket_sla_events_clock:clock_type IS NULL OR clock_type IN ('first_response', 'resolution')

tables.name: users
check_constraints: ck_users_email_normalized:email IS NULL OR email = lower(btrim(email))

tables.name: work_order_checklist_items
check_constraints: ck_wo_checklist_completion_state:((result_status = 'pending' AND completed_at IS NULL AND completed_by_user_id IS NULL) OR (result_status <> 'pending' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL))
ck_wo_checklist_numeric_range:minimum_value IS NULL OR maximum_value IS NULL OR minimum_value <= maximum_value

tables.name: work_order_part_issues
check_constraints: ck_wo_part_issues_quantity:quantity > 0 AND reserved_quantity_used >= 0 AND reserved_quantity_used <= quantity

tables.name: work_orders
check_constraints: ck_work_orders_assignment_state:status IN ('planned', 'cancelled') OR assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL

ck_work_orders_cancelled_state:((status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'cancelled' AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NULL))
ck_work_orders_completed_state:((status IN ('completed', 'verified') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('completed', 'verified') AND completed_at IS NULL))
ck_work_orders_duration:estimated_duration_minutes > 0 AND (labor_minutes IS NULL OR labor_minutes >= 0) AND grace_period_days >= 0
ck_work_orders_hold_state:((status = 'on_hold' AND hold_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'on_hold' AND hold_reason IS NULL))
ck_work_orders_schedule_chronology:scheduled_end_at IS NULL OR scheduled_start_at IS NULL OR scheduled_end_at >= scheduled_start_at

ck_work_orders_started_state:((status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'verified') AND started_at IS NOT NULL) OR status IN ('assigned', 'on_hold', 'cancelled') OR (status = 'planned' AND started_at IS NULL))
ck_work_orders_verified_state:((status = 'verified' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'verified' AND verified_at IS NULL AND verified_by_user_id IS NULL))
indexes: uq_work_orders_active_corrective_ticket:True:source_ticket_id:source_ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND work_order_type = 'corrective' AND status NOT IN ('verified', 'cancelled')
